claim: The public result contains only Markdown and title; the converter interface returns that result; no structured provenance or artifact contract exists.
All source forms are buffered; only remote responses have a default 32 MiB cap; caller hints override source facts and fact origin is not retained.
Generic ZIP enforces 256 entries 8 MiB per entry 32 MiB aggregate and depth four but skips unsupported and most failed members.
EPUB OOXML and XLSX use independent ZIP-backed readers without the generic ZIP aggregate policy.
PDF conversion already extracts ordered image bytes and metadata but exposes them only as optional base64 Markdown data URIs.
Normal conversion is specified never to auto-download components; installed manifests already model component provider version backend and file digests.
Public typed errors support category matching but fallback attempt information is returned only when every converter fails.
The CLI deadline wrapper may return when context expires while non-cooperative conversion continues in its goroutine.
Inkbite is MIT licensed and its charter requires MIT-compatible adoption records and explicit authority boundaries.
Adding methods to an exported interface breaks implementations; adding fields breaks unkeyed literals and can break comparability; v1-compatible changes require additive APIs.
SHA-256 identifies exact bytes with a 256-bit digest but matching digest data alone does not authenticate or authorize the source.
Go follows redirects by default and exposes redirect and connection hooks; default transport may use ambient proxies and transparent compression.
Go documents that IsPrivate covers limited ranges and is not an access-control predicate; IsGlobalUnicast includes private addresses.
The IPv4 special-purpose registry contains non-public classes beyond RFC1918 private space.
IPv6 has its own special-purpose classes and HTTP automatic redirects require rejecting userinfo and protecting sensitive fields.
MIT is the SPDX identifier and its notice must accompany copies or substantial portions.
SPDX identifiers supplement rather than replace notices and package provenance separates version VCS location license copyright and attribution.
Compressed inputs can amplify resource use; ZIP header sizes are only admission hints while actual reads checksums path safety duplicates and limit-plus-one detection require explicit enforcement.
Context cancellation signals work to stop but does not wait for completion; terminal cleanup must synchronize mission-owned workers.
